label: D3_PROPOSAL_V1_FREEZE
purpose: Proposal threshold for TARGET_DIVER_SELECTION_V2. Separates "candidate proposal recall" from "target selection" per V2 packet design.
note: proposal_conf=0.05 is identical to the D3.1 operating point (D3_1_OPERATING_POINT_FREEZE.json). Lower thresholds were evaluated: conf=0.005 gives recall=77.4% (24/31) vs conf=0.05 recall=71.0% (22/31). The 2541 zero-detection frames (525, 558) have max_conf=0.039/0.011 below 0.05; at conf=0.005 they appear (candidates match GT). However ceiling at conf=0.005 (77.4%) remains below the 80% gate even with this improvement, because 7/9 miss frames are wrong-location (detector fires at wrong objects, not missing completely). Freezing at conf=0.05 avoids re-running full inference while acknowledging the 77% partial ceiling.
